category_title: Preschoolers with autism exhibiting high rates of unengagement and social-communication deficits
minimal_context: The student is sitting at the table during snack time with a cup of juice and crackers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for snack. Here is your cup of juice and your crackers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the cup and spins it on the table in a rigid, stereotyped manner instead of drinking.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops spinning the cup and sits with hands in lap, waiting in a passive manner without looking at the tutor.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You should eat your snack now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains completely unengaged, staring blankly across the room and showing no person engagement during the caregiving activity.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for snack. Here is your cup of juice and your crackers.

STUDENT: (Takes the cup and spins it on the table in a rigid, stereotyped manner instead of drinking.)

TUTOR: Please drink your juice.

STUDENT: (Stops spinning the cup and sits with hands in lap, waiting in a passive manner without looking at the tutor.)

TUTOR: You should eat your snack now.

STUDENT: (Remains completely unengaged, staring blankly across the room and showing no person engagement during the caregiving activity.)

task.content: eating/drinking or waiting in a passive manner

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: spent signiﬁcantly more time spent unengaged during caregiving activities than in any of the other activities

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: spent a signiﬁcantly lower percentage of time in person engagement
